name: Ookouchi Ryouko
source:
She has a spirited personality and a sporty look. She is a competitive runner currently conditioning and preparing for a tournament taking place next month. She has little experience with men. 

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
